content.title: Euphoria season 3 release schedule: When is episode 2 out in the UK and US?
content.text: Four years after the release of Euphoria season 2, the third season of the HBO series is finally here.It's been a long wait for fans of the angsty, teen drama and now, our cast of main characters have all grown up and gone out into the adult world – but their problems continue.As the premiere episode maps out, things haven't exactly gone to plan for Rue (Zendaya) with Laurie's (Martha Kelly) missing suitcase of drugs from season 2 being the storyline that comes home to roost.Now indebted to Laurie and working as a drugs mule, we get insight into Rue's new lifestyle as she winds up south of the border in Mexico. Fans have already taken to social media to share their divided reaction to what Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) is up to this season, as she's now engaged and waiting to be wed to Nate (Jacob Elordi).But with episodes airing weekly, when can fans get their next dose of Euphoria? Read on to find out more about the release schedule of the returning drama.When did Euphoria season 3 premiere in the UK?Euphoria season 3 poster. HBOThe third season of Euphoria premiered in the UK on Monday 13th April on HBO Max, Sky Atlantic and NOW. Episodes air on Sky Atlantic weekly at 2am on Mondays here in the UK to coincide with US release on Sundays.In the US, Euphoria season 3 premiered on Sunday 12th April.Jacob Elordi in Euphoria season 3. HBOThe full release schedule for Euphoria season 3 is as follows, complete with release dates for both the UK and US.Episode 1 - Ándale - UK: Monday 13 April and US: Sunday 12 April (out now)Episode 2 - America My Dream - UK: Monday 20 April and US: Sunday 19 April Episode 3 - The Ballad of Paladin - UK: Monday 27 April and US: Sunday 26 April Episode 4 - Kitty Likes to Dance - UK: Monday 4 May and US: Sunday 3 May Episode 5 - This Little Piggy - UK: Monday 11 May and US: Sunday 10 May Episode 6 - Stand Still and See - UK: Monday 18 May and US: Sunday 17 May Episode 7 - Rain or Shine - UK: Monday 25 May and US: Sunday 24 May Episode 8 - In God We Trust - UK: Monday 1 June and US: Sunday 31 May How many episodes of Euphoria season 3 are there?There will be eight episodes in the third season of Euphoria. It follows the previous two seasons that were both also comprised of eight episodes.Euphoria season 3 trailerYou can find the trailer for Euphoria season 3 below.Euphoria season 3 is airing weekly on HBO Max, Sky Atlantic and NOW.
